note: Ground-floor entrance hall of the clock tower (stone flagstones). Feminine nouns on the left (l'heure, la nuit, la journée, la minute); masculine on the right (le jour, le temps, l'instant, le soir, le moment, le matin). Green front door on the far left back out to the tower forecourt; the archway on the far right leads to the seasons room. Zoom: the sideboard on the back wall (behind the doorman).
